The provided data describes a virtual machine running on QEMU. QEMU (Quick EMUlator) is a free and open-source emulator and virtualizer. It is an international open-source project, first released in 2003 by French programmer Fabrice Bellard. The official website for QEMU is www.qemu.org.

The asset represents a "Standard PC (Q35 + ICH9, 2009)" virtual machine, configured with a "qemu virtual cpu version 2.5+" and 8 GB of RAM. The virtual machine also has 4 logical processors and an emulated "intel(r) pro/1000 mt network connection" adapter. The storage is indicated as 100 GB. The virtual machine uses a Q35 chipset and an ICH9 southbridge, which are emulated components.
